title: Northgate Visa Discount on Northgate Delivery & Installation Reschedule Fees
content:
A Northgate Visa discount is taken off once from the reschedule fee owed on a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment — from the whole of the fee owed for the moves that owe one, being each move's fee with every charge added to it, times those moves. The discount follows two records:

- the tender the purchase being delivered was paid with, as the purchase record under Northgate Purchases & Returns shows it; and
- where the automatic renewal of the membership presented on that purchase is billed, as Northgate Memberships shows it.

| Purchase paid with the Northgate Visa | Automatic renewal of the presented membership billed to the Northgate Visa | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 50 percent off |
| Yes | No | 25 percent off |
| No | Yes | 25 percent off |
| No | No | Nothing off |

When both are on the Northgate Visa, 50 percent comes off; when exactly one of the two is, 25 percent comes off; when neither is, nothing comes off.

## Hypothetical figures

A fee owed of $120.00 across the owed moves becomes $60.00 with both on the Northgate Visa, $90.00 with exactly one, and stays $120.00 with neither. The discount is taken once, from the whole fee owed, and the result is then rounded to the cent.
